answer.text:
Start a free Discourse trial

Create a hosted Discourse community in a few minutes. No credit card is needed to begin the trial.

Choose a subdomain for your community, add your branding, and invite members. Hosted plans include upgrades, backups and support.

Subdomain (.discourse.example)

By starting a trial you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

results.title: Discourse Pricing: Hosted Community Plans
results.description: Compare Discourse hosting plans for communities of different sizes, including Standard, Business and Enterprise tiers. Hosted plans include upgrades, backups and support. A free trial is available before you choose a plan.

results.title: Start a free Discourse trial
results.description: Create a hosted Discourse community with a free trial. Choose a subdomain, add your branding, and invite members. No credit card is needed to begin the trial.

results.title: Discourse hosting FAQ: billing, trials and cancellation
results.description: Answers to common questions about hosted Discourse: how trial periods work, when billing starts, how plan changes are prorated, and how to cancel or export your data.

results.title: Self-hosting Discourse vs. hosted Discourse
results.description: Installation guide for running Discourse on your own server. Covers the hardware and software requirements, and notes that the official hosting service is an alternative to self-hosting.

results.title: Discourse community forum software review 2026
results.description: A review of Discourse for small product communities. It covers hosting costs, the free trial, moderation tools and how Discourse compares with other forum platforms on price.
